name: 27616 · Raleigh, NC
findings: ZIP 27616 (Raleigh) has 166 nonprofit organizations. 78 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 64 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27616 (Raleigh) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
